original_intent: Keep GitHub Actions workflow YAML as the canonical CI and release contract, execute it through Buildkite, and document the adapter failures and working paths for escalation to Buildkite engineering.
derived_intent: Update PR #1344 and Issue #1340 to preserve the github-actions adapter, defer native pipeline migration, separate repository and adapter failures, and record the exact compatibility work required before retiring GitHub Actions.
active_boundaries: Do not change .github/workflows/*.yml; preserve the Buildkite github-actions adapter; do not disable workflow gates; do not merge the native pipeline rewrite.
repo_scope: PR #1344, Issue #1340, Buildkite adapter evidence, .buildkite README, living specs, and governance artifacts
evidence: Build #56 also failed Deploy Docs/build and Release/release-publish under the adapter.
Build #70 adapter-backed format, clippy, governance, health, contract, daemonless, migration, test, docs, and artifact checks passed; setup, deps-lint, and Release/plan failed.

Host decapod validate refreshed release-bound projections to 0.103.0 but requires a real container workspace; the managed image's Cargo 1.65 cannot parse edition 2024, and the temporary Rust 1.96 image build was not completed.
The native .buildkite/pipeline.yml upload experiment is deferred; .github/workflows/*.yml remains canonical.
The prepared Decapod validation container provides cargo 1.65.0, which cannot parse Cargo edition 2024; configured migration proof exits 101 before tests.
unresolved_assumptions: Buildkite engineering can diagnose adapter compatibility from complete workflow logs, plugin/agent versions, and failing commits without requiring workflow rewrites.
completion_claim: PR #1344 and Issue #1340 now describe the adapter-first decision, working paths, broken paths, local validation limitation, and next escalation work.
